Handoff — self-hosted share links for big files.
Mount a folder on your array and browse it. Click a file to share it as-is, or share a whole folder and Handoff zips it with no compression. Set an expiry and the link stops working on its own. Your mounted folder is only ever read from.
Built for the "just send me the photos" problem, without standing up a full cloud-storage stack.
